class PH extends h.Component {
    constructor(s) {
        super(s),
        this.state = {
            hasError: !1,
            errorMessage: "",
            errorLocation: s.location
        }
    }
    static getDerivedStateFromError(s) {
        return {
            hasError: !0,
            errorMessage: s.message
        }
    }
    static getDerivedStateFromProps(s, a) {
        return a.hasError && s.location !== a.errorLocation ? {
            hasError: !1,
            errorMessage: "",
            errorLocation: s.location
        } : null
    }
    render() {
        return this.state.hasError ? e.jsxs("div", {
            className: "flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full py-20 text-center px-4",
            children: [e.jsx(Cs, {
                className: "w-12 h-12 text-destructive opacity-60 mb-4"
            }), e.jsx("h2", {
                className: "text-lg font-semibold mb-2",
                children: "Erro ao renderizar esta página"
            }), e.jsx("p", {
                className: "text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-6 max-w-sm",
                children: this.state.errorMessage || "Ocorreu um erro inesperado. Tente recarregar a página."
            }), e.jsxs(T, {
                variant: "outline",
                onClick: () => {
                    this.setState({
                        hasError: !1,
                        errorMessage: ""
                    }),
                    window.location.reload()
                }
                ,
                children: [e.jsx(Ia, {
                    className: "w-4 h-4 mr-2"
                }), "Recarregar"]
            })]
        }) : this.props.children
    }
}

function jQ(t) {
    if (!t)
        return "Pessoa indicada";
    const s = t.trim().split(/\s+/);
    return s.length === 1 ? `${s[0].charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${s[0].slice(1, 3)}***` : `${s[0]} ${s[s.length - 1].charAt(0).toUpperCase()}.`
}
function vQ(t) {
    if (!t)
        return "";

    return a ? `${s.slice(0, Math.min(3, s.length))}***@${a}` : t
}

function Bg(t, s, a) {
    if (s)
        return "bg-primary border-2 border-primary text-primary-foreground cursor-pointer";
    if (a === "wc")
        return "bg-cyan-100 border-2 border-cyan-300 text-cyan-700 cursor-not-allowed";
    if (a === "stairs")
        return "bg-purple-100 border-2 border-purple-300 text-purple-700 cursor-not-allowed";
    if (a === "fridge")
        return "bg-sky-100 border-2 border-sky-300 text-sky-700 cursor-not-allowed";
    if (a === "blocked")
        return "bg-gray-100 border-2 border-gray-300 text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed";
    switch (t) {
    case "available":
        return a === "vip" ? "bg-yellow-50 border-2 border-yellow-500 hover:border-yellow-600 hover:bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 cursor-pointer shadow-[0_0_0_1px_theme(colors.yellow.400)]" : a === "accessible" ? "bg-blue-50 border-2 border-blue-400 hover:border-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 cursor-pointer" : "bg-white border-2 border-gray-200 hover:border-primary hover:bg-primary/10 cursor-pointer";
    case "reserved":
    case "occupied":
        return "bg-orange-400 border-2 border-orange-500 text-white cursor-not-allowed";
    case tt.CONFIRMED:
        return "bg-green-500 border-2 border-green-600 text-white cursor-not-allowed";
    case "free":
        return "bg-violet-500 border-2 border-violet-600 text-white cursor-not-allowed";
    case "blocked":
    case "wc":
    case "stairs":
    case "fridge":
        return "bg-gray-100 border-2 border-gray-200 text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed";
    default:
        return "bg-gray-100 border-2 border-gray-200 cursor-not-allowed"
    }
}
function Hc(t, s) {
    switch (t) {
    case "wc":
        return "🚽";
    case "stairs":
        return "🪜";
    case "fridge":
        return "🧊";
    case "blocked":
        return "✕";
    case "vip":
        return "★";
    case "accessible":
        return "♿";
    default:
        return s ?? ""
    }
}

function _m(t, s) {

        fridge: "Frigobar",
        blocked: "Bloqueado",
        vip: `Assento VIP ${t.number}`,
        accessible: `Assento Acessível ${t.number}`
    };
    if (t.type && a[t.type])
        return a[t.type];
    if (s)
        return `Assento ${t.number} — Selecionado`;
    if (t.status === "free") {
        const n = t.occupantName;
        return `Assento ${t.number} — Gratuidade${n ? `: ${n}` : ""}`
    }
    return `Assento ${t.number} — ${t.status}`
}

                            children: ["R$ ", t.totalValue.toFixed(2)]
                        })]
                    })]
                })]
            })]
        }), e.jsxs("div", {
            className: "flex justify-between gap-2 pt-2",
            children: [e.jsx(T, {
                variant: "outline",
                onClick: t.onBack,
                children: "← Anterior"
            }), e.jsx(T, {
                onClick: t.onNext,
                disabled: t.totalValue < 0,
                children: "Próximo →"
            })]
        })]
    })
}
function DY({step: t}) {
    const s = ["Seleção", "Pagamento", "Confirmação"];
    return e.jsx("div", {
        className: "flex items-center gap-0 mb-6",
        children: s.map( (a, n) => {
            const r = n + 1
              , i = r === t
              , o = r < t;
            return e.jsxs("div", {
                className: "flex items-center flex-1",
                children: [e.jsxs("div", {
                    className: "flex flex-col items-center gap-1",
                    children: [e.jsx("div", {
                        className: `w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold border-2 transition-colors ${o ? "bg-primary border-primary text-primary-foreground" : i ? "border-primary text-primary bg-primary/10" : "border-muted-foreground/30 text-muted-foreground"}`,
                        children: o ? "✓" : r
                    }), e.jsx("span", {
                        className: `text-xs whitespace-nowrap ${i ? "text-primary font-semibold" : "text-muted-foreground"}`,
                        children: a
                    })]
                }), n < s.length - 1 && e.jsx("div", {
                    className: `flex-1 h-0.5 mx-1 mt-[-12px] transition-colors ${o ? "bg-primary" : "bg-muted"}`
                })]
            }, r)
        }
        )
    })
}

function nX(t, s) {
    const a = (t.toString().split(".")[1] || "").length
      , n = (s.toString().split(".")[1] || "").length
      , r = a > n ? a : n
      , i = Number.parseInt(t.toFixed(r).replace(".", ""))
      , o = Number.parseInt(s.toFixed(r).replace(".", ""));
    return i % o / 10 ** r
}
class xd extends ea {
    constructor() {
        super(...arguments),
        this.min = this.gte,
        this.max = this.lte,
        this.step = this.multipleOf
    }
    _parse(s) {
        if (this._def.coerce && (s.data = Number(s.data)),
        this._getType(s) !== Kt.number) {
            const i = this._getOrReturnCtx(s);
            return Ot(i, {
                code: bt.invalid_type,
                expected: Kt.number,
                received: i.parsedType
            }),
            Ns
        }
        let n;
        const r = new Zr;
        for (const i of this._def.checks)
            i.kind === "int" ? na.isInteger(s.data) || (n = this._getOrReturnCtx(s, n),
            Ot(n, {
                code: bt.invalid_type,
                expected: "integer",
                received: "float",
                message: i.message
            }),
            r.dirty()) : i.kind === "min" ? (i.inclusive ? s.data < i.value : s.data <= i.value) && (n = this._getOrReturnCtx(s, n),
            Ot(n, {
                code: bt.too_small,
                minimum: i.value,
                type: "number",
                inclusive: i.inclusive,
                exact: !1,
                message: i.message
            }),
            r.dirty()) : i.kind === "max" ? (i.inclusive ? s.data > i.value : s.data >= i.value) && (n = this._getOrReturnCtx(s, n),
            Ot(n, {
                code: bt.too_big,
                maximum: i.value,
                type: "number",
                inclusive: i.inclusive,
                exact: !1,
                message: i.message
            }),
            r.dirty()) : i.kind === "multipleOf" ? nX(s.data, i.value) !== 0 && (n = this._getOrReturnCtx(s, n),
            Ot(n, {
                code: bt.not_multiple_of,
                multipleOf: i.value,
                message: i.message
            }),
            r.dirty()) : i.kind === "finite" ? Number.isFinite(s.data) || (n = this._getOrReturnCtx(s, n),
            Ot(n, {
                code: bt.not_finite,
                message: i.message
            }),
            r.dirty()) : na.assertNever(i);
        return {
            status: r.value,
            value: s.data
        }
    }
    gte(s, a) {
        return this.setLimit("min", s, !0, Yt.toString(a))
    }
    gt(s, a) {
        return this.setLimit("min", s, !1, Yt.toString(a))
    }
    lte(s, a) {
        return this.setLimit("max", s, !0, Yt.toString(a))
    }
    lt(s, a) {
        return this.setLimit("max", s, !1, Yt.toString(a))
    }
    setLimit(s, a, n, r) {
        return new xd({
            ...this._def,
            checks: [...this._def.checks, {
                kind: s,
                value: a,
                inclusive: n,
                message: Yt.toString(r)
            }]
        })
    }
    _addCheck(s) {
        return new xd({
            ...this._def,
            checks: [...this._def.checks, s]
        })
    }
    int(s) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "int",
            message: Yt.toString(s)
        })
    }
    positive(s) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "min",
            value: 0,
            inclusive: !1,
            message: Yt.toString(s)
        })
    }
    negative(s) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "max",
            value: 0,
            inclusive: !1,
            message: Yt.toString(s)
        })
    }
    nonpositive(s) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "max",
            value: 0,
            inclusive: !0,
            message: Yt.toString(s)
        })
    }
    nonnegative(s) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "min",
            value: 0,
            inclusive: !0,
            message: Yt.toString(s)
        })
    }
    multipleOf(s, a) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "multipleOf",
            value: s,
            message: Yt.toString(a)
        })
    }
    finite(s) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "finite",
            message: Yt.toString(s)
        })
    }
    safe(s) {
        return this._addCheck({
            kind: "min",
            inclusive: !0,
            value: Number.MIN_SAFE_INTEGER,
            message: Yt.toString(s)
        })._addCheck({
            kind: "max",
            inclusive: !0,
            value: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,
            message: Yt.toString(s)
        })
    }
    get minValue() {
        let s = null;
        for (const a of this._def.checks)
            a.kind === "min" && (s === null || a.value > s) && (s = a.value);
        return s
    }
    get maxValue() {
        let s = null;
        for (const a of this._def.checks)
            a.kind === "max" && (s === null || a.value < s) && (s = a.value);
        return s
    }
    get isInt() {
        return !!this._def.checks.find(s => s.kind === "int" || s.kind === "multipleOf" && na.isInteger(s.value))
    }
    get isFinite() {
        let s = null
          , a = null;
        for (const n of this._def.checks) {
            if (n.kind === "finite" || n.kind === "int" || n.kind === "multipleOf")
                return !0;
            n.kind === "min" ? (a === null || n.value > a) && (a = n.value) : n.kind === "max" && (s === null || n.value < s) && (s = n.value)
        }
        return Number.isFinite(a) && Number.isFinite(s)
    }
}

class Xi extends ea {
    _parse(s) {
        const {ctx: a, status: n} = this._processInputParams(s)
          , r = this._def;
        if (a.parsedType !== Kt.array)
            return Ot(a, {
                code: bt.invalid_type,
                expected: Kt.array,
                received: a.parsedType
            }),
            Ns;
        if (r.exactLength !== null) {
            const o = a.data.length > r.exactLength.value
              , l = a.data.length < r.exactLength.value;
            (o || l) && (Ot(a, {
                code: o ? bt.too_big : bt.too_small,
                minimum: l ? r.exactLength.value : void 0,
                maximum: o ? r.exactLength.value : void 0,
                type: "array",
                inclusive: !0,
                exact: !0,
                message: r.exactLength.message
            }),
            n.dirty())
        }
        if (r.minLength !== null && a.data.length < r.minLength.value && (Ot(a, {
            code: bt.too_small,
            minimum: r.minLength.value,
            type: "array",
            inclusive: !0,
            exact: !1,
            message: r.minLength.message
        }),
        n.dirty()),
        r.maxLength !== null && a.data.length > r.maxLength.value && (Ot(a, {
            code: bt.too_big,
            maximum: r.maxLength.value,
            type: "array",
            inclusive: !0,
            exact: !1,
            message: r.maxLength.message
        }),
        n.dirty()),
        a.common.async)
            return Promise.all([...a.data].map( (o, l) => r.type._parseAsync(new vl(a,o,a.path,l)))).then(o => Zr.mergeArray(n, o));
        const i = [...a.data].map( (o, l) => r.type._parseSync(new vl(a,o,a.path,l)));
        return Zr.mergeArray(n, i)
    }
    get element() {
        return this._def.type
    }
    min(s, a) {
        return new Xi({
            ...this._def,
            minLength: {
                value: s,
                message: Yt.toString(a)
            }
        })
    }
    max(s, a) {
        return new Xi({
            ...this._def,
            maxLength: {
                value: s,
                message: Yt.toString(a)
            }
        })
    }
    length(s, a) {
        return new Xi({
            ...this._def,
            exactLength: {
                value: s,
                message: Yt.toString(a)
            }
        })
    }
    nonempty(s) {
        return this.min(1, s)
    }
}

function Vc(t) {
    if (t instanceof rn) {
        const s = {};
        for (const a in t.shape) {
            const n = t.shape[a];
            s[a] = dl.create(Vc(n))
        }
        return new rn({
            ...t._def,
            shape: () => s
        })
    } else
        return t instanceof Xi ? new Xi({
            ...t._def,
            type: Vc(t.element)
        }) : t instanceof dl ? dl.create(Vc(t.unwrap())) : t instanceof fd ? fd.create(Vc(t.unwrap())) : t instanceof tc ? tc.create(t.items.map(s => Vc(s))) : t
}
class rn extends ea {
    constructor() {
        super(...arguments),
        this._cached = null,
        this.nonstrict = this.passthrough,
        this.augment = this.extend
    }
    _getCached() {
        if (this._cached !== null)
            return this._cached;
        const s = this._def.shape()
          , a = na.objectKeys(s);
        return this._cached = {
            shape: s,
            keys: a
        },
        this._cached
    }
    _parse(s) {
        if (this._getType(s) !== Kt.object) {
            const d = this._getOrReturnCtx(s);
            return Ot(d, {
                code: bt.invalid_type,
                expected: Kt.object,
                received: d.parsedType
            }),
            Ns
        }
        const {status: n, ctx: r} = this._processInputParams(s)
          , {shape: i, keys: o} = this._getCached()
          , l = [];
        if (!(this._def.catchall instanceof yl && this._def.unknownKeys === "strip"))
            for (const d in r.data)
                o.includes(d) || l.push(d);

        for (const d of o) {
            const u = i[d]
              , m = r.data[d];
            c.push({
                key: {
                    status: "valid",
                    value: d
                },
                value: u._parse(new vl(r,m,r.path,d)),
                alwaysSet: d in r.data
            })

            if (d === "passthrough")

                    c.push({

                            value: u
                        },
                        value: {
                            status: "valid",
                            value: r.data[u]

                    });

                l.length > 0 && (Ot(r, {

                    keys: l
                }),

            for (const u of l) {

                c.push({

                        status: "valid",
                        value: u
                    },

                })

                })

    }

    }

                    }

    }

        })
    }

        })
    }

            catchall: s
        })
    }

        for (const n of na.objectKeys(s))
            s[n] && this.shape[n] && (a[n] = this.shape[n]);

            shape: () => a
        })
    }

            s[n] || (a[n] = this.shape[n]);
        return new rn({
            ...this._def,
            shape: () => a
        })
    }

        return Vc(this)
    }
    partial(s) {
        const a = {};
        for (const n of na.objectKeys(this.shape)) {
            const r = this.shape[n];
            s && !s[n] ? a[n] = r : a[n] = r.optional()
        }
        return new rn({
            ...this._def,
            shape: () => a
        })
    }
    required(s) {
        const a = {};
        for (const n of na.objectKeys(this.shape))
            if (s && !s[n])
                a[n] = this.shape[n];
            else {
                let i = this.shape[n];
                for (; i instanceof dl; )
                    i = i._def.innerType;
                a[n] = i
            }

            ...this._def,
            shape: () => a
        })
    }

        return Q4(na.objectKeys(this.shape))
    }

function Hg(t, s) {
    const a = Xo(t)
      , n = Xo(s);
    if (t === s)
        return {
            valid: !0,
            data: t
        };
    if (a === Kt.object && n === Kt.object) {
        const r = na.objectKeys(s)
          , i = na.objectKeys(t).filter(l => r.indexOf(l) !== -1)
          , o = {
            ...t,
            ...s
        };
        for (const l of i) {
            const c = Hg(t[l], s[l]);
            if (!c.valid)
                return {
                    valid: !1
                };
            o[l] = c.data
        }
        return {
            valid: !0,
            data: o
        }
    } else if (a === Kt.array && n === Kt.array) {
        if (t.length !== s.length)
            return {
                valid: !1
            };
        const r = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < t.length; i++) {
            const o = t[i]
              , l = s[i]
              , c = Hg(o, l);
            if (!c.valid)
                return {
                    valid: !1
                };
            r.push(c.data)
        }
        return {
            valid: !0,
            data: r
        }
    } else
        return a === Kt.date && n === Kt.date && +t == +s ? {
            valid: !0,
            data: t
        } : {
            valid: !1
        }
}

class pd extends ea {
    innerType() {
        return this._def.schema
    }
    sourceType() {
        return this._def.schema._def.typeName === ws.ZodEffects ? this._def.schema.sourceType() : this._def.schema
    }
    _parse(s) {
        const {status: a, ctx: n} = this._processInputParams(s)
          , r = this._def.effect || null
          , i = {
            addIssue: o => {
                Ot(n, o),
                o.fatal ? a.abort() : a.dirty()
            }
            ,
            get path() {
                return n.path
            }
        };
        if (i.addIssue = i.addIssue.bind(i),
        r.type === "preprocess") {
            const o = r.transform(n.data, i);
            if (n.common.async)
                return Promise.resolve(o).then(async l => {
                    if (a.value === "aborted")
                        return Ns;
                    const c = await this._def.schema._parseAsync({
                        data: l,
                        path: n.path,
                        parent: n
                    });
                    return c.status === "aborted" ? Ns : c.status === "dirty" || a.value === "dirty" ? su(c.value) : c
                }
                );
            {
                if (a.value === "aborted")
                    return Ns;
                const l = this._def.schema._parseSync({
                    data: o,
                    path: n.path,
                    parent: n
                });
                return l.status === "aborted" ? Ns : l.status === "dirty" || a.value === "dirty" ? su(l.value) : l
            }
        }
        if (r.type === "refinement") {
            const o = l => {
                const c = r.refinement(l, i);
                if (n.common.async)
                    return Promise.resolve(c);
                if (c instanceof Promise)
                    throw new Error("Async refinement encountered during synchronous parse operation. Use .parseAsync instead.");
                return l
            }
            ;
            if (n.common.async === !1) {
                const l = this._def.schema._parseSync({
                    data: n.data,
                    path: n.path,
                    parent: n
                });
                return l.status === "aborted" ? Ns : (l.status === "dirty" && a.dirty(),
                o(l.value),
                {
                    status: a.value,
                    value: l.value
                })
            } else
                return this._def.schema._parseAsync({
                    data: n.data,
                    path: n.path,
                    parent: n
                }).then(l => l.status === "aborted" ? Ns : (l.status === "dirty" && a.dirty(),
                o(l.value).then( () => ({
                    status: a.value,
                    value: l.value
                }))))
        }
        if (r.type === "transform")
            if (n.common.async === !1) {
                const o = this._def.schema._parseSync({
                    data: n.data,
                    path: n.path,
                    parent: n
                });
                if (!md(o))
                    return Ns;
                const l = r.transform(o.value, i);
                if (l instanceof Promise)
                    throw new Error("Asynchronous transform encountered during synchronous parse operation. Use .parseAsync instead.");
                return {
                    status: a.value,
                    value: l
                }
            } else
                return this._def.schema._parseAsync({
                    data: n.data,
                    path: n.path,
                    parent: n
                }).then(o => md(o) ? Promise.resolve(r.transform(o.value, i)).then(l => ({
                    status: a.value,
                    value: l
                })) : Ns);
        na.assertNever(r)
    }
}

function gX(t) {
    if (!t)
        return {
            prefix: "—",
            typeCode: "—",
            yearMonth: "—",
            sequenceStr: "—"
        };
    const s = t.split("-");
    return {
        prefix: s[0] ?? "—",
        typeCode: s[1] ?? "—",
        yearMonth: s[2] ?? "—",
        sequenceStr: s[3] ?? "—"
    }
}
function jX(t) {
    return {
        EXC: "Excursão",
        PCT: "Pacote",
        BTV: "Bate-volta",
        RES: "Reserva",
        TRF: "Transfer"
    }[t] ?? t
}
function wN(t) {
    return t === tt.CONFIRMED ? "bg-green-500" : t === tt.CANCELLED ? "bg-red-500" : "bg-yellow-400"
}
function CN(t) {
    return t === tt.CONFIRMED ? "Confirmada" : t === tt.CANCELLED ? "Cancelada" : "Pendente"
}
function vX(t) {
    return t <= 0 ? "Pago" : "Pendente"
}
function yX(t) {
    if (!t || t === "—")
        return t;
    const s = t.substring(0, 4);
    return `${t.substring(4, 6)}/${s}`
}

async function eE() {
    const t = await fetch("/api/clients/duplicates");
    if (!t.ok)
        throw new Error("Erro ao buscar duplicatas");
    return t.json()
}
async function BX(t, s) {
    const a = await fetch(`/api/clients/${t}/merge`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
            secondaryId: s
        })
    });
    if (!a.ok) {
        const n = await a.json().catch( () => ({}));
        throw new Error(n.error ?? "Erro ao mesclar clientes")
    }
}
function UX({onMergeComplete: t}) {
    const {toast: s} = lt()
      , a = xa()
      , [n,r] = h.useState(null)
      , {data: i, isLoading: o, error: l} = dt({
        queryKey: ["client-duplicates"],
        queryFn: eE,
        staleTime: 6e4
    })
      , c = rt({
        mutationFn: ({primaryId: x, secondaryId: p}) => BX(x, p),
        onSuccess: () => {
            s({
                title: "Clientes mesclados com sucesso",
                description: "O cadastro duplicado foi incorporado ao perfil principal."
            }),
            a.invalidateQueries({
                queryKey: ["client-duplicates"]
            }),
            a.invalidateQueries({
                queryKey: ["/api/clients"]
            }),
            t(),
            r(null)
        }
        ,
        onError: x => {
            s({
                title: "Erro ao mesclar",
                description: x.message,
                variant: "destructive"
            })
        }
    })
      , d = () => {
        if (!n)
            return;
        const x = n.pair.clients[n.primaryIndex].id
          , p = n.pair.clients[n.primaryIndex === 0 ? 1 : 0].id;
        c.mutate({
            primaryId: x,
            secondaryId: p
        })
    }
      , u = {
        cpf: "Mesmo CPF",
        name_whatsapp: "Mesmo nome e WhatsApp"
    };
    if (o)
        return e.jsxs("div", {
            className: "flex items-center gap-2 py-6 text-sm text-muted-foreground justify-center",

function jf(t) {
    if (t === null || !isFinite(t) || t <= 0)
        return "";
    if (t < 10)
        return "< 10s";
    if (t < 60)
        return `~${Math.round(t)}s`;
    const s = Math.floor(t / 60)
      , a = Math.round(t % 60);
    return s >= 10 ? `~${s}min` : a > 0 ? `~${s}min ${a}s` : `~${s}min`
}

        const s = new URL(t).pathname.toLowerCase();
        return ZX.some(a => s.endsWith(a))
    } catch {
        return !1
    }
}

function kl(t, s, a, n) {
    if (!t || !s)
        return null;
    const r = t.length <= 10 ? t : t.slice(0, 10)
      , i = s.length <= 10 ? s : s.slice(0, 10)
      , [o=0,l=0] = a ? a.split(":").map(Number) : [0, 0]
      , [c=0,d=0] = n ? n.split(":").map(Number) : [0, 0]
      , u = new Date(`${r}T${String(o).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(l).padStart(2, "0")}:00`)
      , m = new Date(`${i}T${String(c).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(d).padStart(2, "0")}:00`)
      , x = Math.max(0, Math.round((m.getTime() - u.getTime()) / 6e4));
    if (x === 0)
        return null;
    const p = Math.floor(x / 1440)
      , g = Math.floor(x % 1440 / 60);
    let f;
    p === 0 ? f = `${g} hora${g !== 1 ? "s" : ""}` : g === 0 ? f = `${p} dia${p !== 1 ? "s" : ""}` : f = `${p} dia${p !== 1 ? "s" : ""} e ${g} hora${g !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`;
    let j;
    return p === 0 ? j = `${g}h` : g === 0 ? j = `${p}d` : j = `${p}d ${g}h`,
    {
        totalMinutes: x,
        days: p,
        hours: g,
        formatted: f,
        formattedShort: j
    }
}

    } catch {
        return ""
    }
}

const iE = "/".replace(/\/$/, "");
async function EJ() {
    return {
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }
}
async function Ja(t, s, a) {
    const n = await EJ()
      , r = await fetch(`${iE}/api${s}`, {
        method: t,
        headers: n,
        credentials: "include",
        body: a != null ? JSON.stringify(a) : void 0
    });
    if (!r.ok) {
        const o = await r.json().catch( () => ({
            error: r.statusText
        }));
        throw new Error(o.error ?? "Request failed")
    }
    if (r.status === 204 || r.headers.get("content-length") === "0")
        return;
    const i = await r.text();
    if (i)
        return JSON.parse(i)
}

    code;
    constructor(s, a) {
        super(s),
        this.name = "PublicApiError",
        this.code = a
    }
}
async function Un(t, s, a) {
    const n = await fetch(`${iE}/api${s}`, {
        method: t,
        headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        body: a != null ? JSON.stringify(a) : void 0
    });
    if (!n.ok) {
        const r = await n.json().catch( () => ({
            error: n.statusText
        }));
        throw new gd(r.error ?? "Request failed",r.code)
    }
    return n.json()
}

        dir: "asc"
    })

      , [y,S] = h.useState(!1)
      , [k,E] = h.useState( () => localStorage.getItem("passengersOverview:exportStatusFilter") ?? "")
      , w = h.useCallback(Ae => {
        localStorage.setItem("passengersOverview:exportStatusFilter", Ae),
        E(Ae)
    }
    , [])
      , [v,C] = h.useState(new Set)
      , [_,O] = h.useState(!1)
      , [R,D] = h.useState(!1)
      , {data: P} = Sn({

const lE = "America/Sao_Paulo";
function BN(t) {
    if (!t)
        return "";
    const s = t.length <= 10 ? new Date(t + "T12:00:00") : new Date(t);
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("pt-BR",{
        timeZone: lE,
        day: "2-digit",
        month: "2-digit",
        year: "numeric"
    }).format(s)
}
function DJ(t) {
    const s = new Date(t);
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("pt-BR",{
        timeZone: lE,
        hour: "2-digit",
        minute: "2-digit"
    }).format(s)
}
function Us(t) {
    return t.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#39;")
}
function _J(t, s, a, n, r, i, o=[], l={}) {

      , p = d?.departureDate && d.departureDate.length > 10 ? DJ(d.departureDate) : ""

function IJ(t, s) {
    const {search: a, categoryFilter: n, boardingStatusFilter: r} = s;
    return t.filter(i => {
        if (a) {
            const o = a.toLowerCase();
            if (!i.name.toLowerCase().includes(o) && !(i.cpf ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(o))
                return !1
        }
        return !(n !== "all" && i.ageCategory !== n || r === "embarcado" && !i.checkedInAt || r === "pendente" && i.checkedInAt)
    }
    )
}

function CZ({data: t}) {
    const s = t.reduce( (i, o) => i + o.value, 0) || 1;
    let a = -90;
    const n = t.map(i => {
        const o = i.value / s * 360
          , l = a;
        return a += o,
        {
            ...i,
            angle: o,
            start: l
        }
    }
    )
      , r = (i, o, l, c) => {
        const d = c * Math.PI / 180;
        return {
            x: i + l * Math.cos(d),
            y: o + l * Math.sin(d)
        }
    }
    ;
    return e.jsxs("div", {
        className: "flex items-center gap-6",
        children: [e.jsx("svg", {
            viewBox: "0 0 100 100",
            className: "w-32 h-32 shrink-0",
            children: n.map( (i, o) => {
                if (i.angle < .1)
                    return null;
                const l = r(50, 50, 40, i.start)
                  , c = r(50, 50, 40, i.start + i.angle)
                  , d = i.angle > 180 ? 1 : 0
                  , u = `M50,50 L${l.x.toFixed(2)},${l.y.toFixed(2)} A40,40 0 ${d},1 ${c.x.toFixed(2)},${c.y.toFixed(2)} Z`;
                return e.jsx("path", {
                    d: u,
                    fill: i.color,
                    stroke: "white",
                    strokeWidth: "1"
                }, o)
            }
            )
        }), e.jsx("div", {
            className: "space-y-2",
            children: t.map( (i, o) => e.jsxs("div", {
                className: "flex items-center gap-2 text-sm",
                children: [e.jsx("span", {
                    className: "w-3 h-3 rounded-sm shrink-0",
                    style: {
                        backgroundColor: i.color
                    }
                }), e.jsx("span", {
                    className: "text-muted-foreground",
                    children: i.label
                }), e.jsxs("span", {
                    className: "font-medium ml-auto pl-4",
                    children: [(i.value / s * 100).toFixed(1), "%"]
                })]
            }, o))
        })]
    })
}
function SZ({data: t}) {
    const s = Math.max(...t.map(a => a.count), 1);
    return e.jsx("div", {
        className: "space-y-2",
        children: t.map( (a, n) => e.jsxs("div", {
            className: "flex items-center gap-3",
            children: [e.jsx("span", {
                className: "text-sm text-muted-foreground w-28 shrink-0",
                children: a.label
            }), e.jsx("div", {
                className: "flex-1 bg-muted rounded-full h-6 overflow-hidden",
                children: e.jsx("div", {
                    className: "h-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-end pr-2",
                    style: {
                        width: `${a.count / s * 100}%`,
                        backgroundColor: a.color
                    },
                    children: e.jsx("span", {
                        className: "text-xs font-medium text-white",
                        children: a.count
                    })
                })
            })]
        }, n))
    })
}

function Pc(t) {
    return t >= 1e6 ? `R$ ${(t / 1e6).toFixed(1)}M` : t >= 1e3 ? `R$ ${(t / 1e3).toFixed(1)}k` : new Intl.NumberFormat("pt-BR",{
        style: "currency",
        currency: "BRL",
        maximumFractionDigits: 0
    }).format(t)
}
function BZ(t) {
    const s = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(t).getTime()) / 1e3);
    return s < 60 ? `${s}s atrás` : s < 3600 ? `${Math.floor(s / 60)}min atrás` : `${Math.floor(s / 3600)}h atrás`
}

function tee({data: t}) {
    const s = Math.max(...t.map(a => a.total), 1);
    return e.jsx("div", {
        className: "space-y-3",
        children: t.map(a => {
            const n = a.total / s * 100;
            return e.jsxs("div", {
                className: "flex items-center gap-3",
                children: [e.jsx("span", {
                    className: "text-xs text-muted-foreground w-28 shrink-0",
                    children: rp[a.category] ?? a.category
                }), e.jsx("div", {
                    className: "flex-1 bg-muted rounded-full h-2",
                    children: e.jsx("div", {
                        className: "h-2 rounded-full",
                        style: {
                            width: `${n}%`,
                            backgroundColor: eee[a.category] ?? "#94A3B8"
                        }
                    })
                }), e.jsx("span", {
                    className: "text-xs font-medium w-24 text-right",
                    children: Ll(a.total)
                })]
            }, a.category)
        }
        )
    })
}

function Nee(t, s, a=[]) {
    const n = [];
    for (let r = 1; r <= t; r++)
        for (let i = 1; i <= s; i++) {
            const o = i === s
              , l = r > t - 1 && a.includes(i);
            n.push({
                row: r,
                col: i,
                floor: 1,
                type: l ? "wc" : o && r === 1 ? "stairs" : "seat"
            })
        }
    return n
}

  , Fj = ["seat", "vip", "accessible"];
function bee(t, s) {
    const a = s > 1
      , n = t.filter(u => Fj.includes(u.type))
      , r = n.length > 0 ? Math.max(...n.map(u => u.col)) : 4
      , i = Math.ceil(r / 2)
      , o = new Map;
    for (const u of n) {
        const m = `${u.floor ?? 1}-${u.row}`;
        o.has(m) || o.set(m, []),
        o.get(m).push(u)
    }
    const l = [...o.entries()].sort( ([u], [m]) => {
        const [x,p] = u.split("-").map(Number)
          , [g,f] = m.split("-").map(Number);
        return x !== g ? a ? g - x : x - g : p - f
    }
    )
      , c = new Map;
    let d = 1;
    for (const [,u] of l) {
        const m = u.filter(g => g.col <= i).sort( (g, f) => g.col - f.col)
          , x = u.filter(g => g.col > i).sort( (g, f) => g.col - f.col);
        for (const g of m)
            c.set(`${g.floor ?? 1}-${g.row}-${g.col}`, String(d++));
        const p = d;
        for (let g = 0; g < x.length; g++) {
            const f = x[g];
            c.set(`${f.floor ?? 1}-${f.row}-${f.col}`, String(p + (x.length - 1 - g)))
        }
        d += x.length
    }
    return t.map(u => {
        const m = `${u.floor ?? 1}-${u.row}-${u.col}`
          , x = c.get(m);
        if (x !== void 0)
            return {
                ...u,
                label: x
            };
        const {label: p, ...g} = u;
        return g
    }
    )
}
function wee(t, s, a={
    rows: 12,
    cols: 4
}) {
    const n = {};
    for (let r = 1; r <= s; r++) {
        const i = t.filter(o => (o.floor ?? 1) === r);
        i.length > 0 ? n[r] = {
            rows: Math.max(...i.map(o => o.row)),
            cols: Math.max(...i.map(o => o.col))
        } : n[r] = {
            rows: a.rows,
            cols: a.cols
        }
    }
    return n
}
function Cf(t, s=[]) {
    const a = new Map(s.map(i => [`${i.floor ?? 1}-${i.row}-${i.col}`, i]))
      , n = []
      , r = Object.keys(t).map(Number).sort();
    for (const i of r) {
        const {rows: o, cols: l} = t[i];
        for (let c = 1; c <= o; c++)
            for (let d = 1; d <= l; d++) {
                const u = `${i}-${c}-${d}`;
                n.push(a.get(u) ?? {
                    row: c,
                    col: d,
                    floor: i,
                    type: "seat"
                })
            }
    }
    return n
}
function Cee(t, s) {
    const a = new Map
      , n = Fj
      , r = s.endsWith("_upper_first")
      , i = r ? s.replace("_upper_first", "") : s
      , o = u => `${u.floor ?? 1}-${u.row}-${u.col}`
      , l = t.filter(u => n.includes(u.type)).sort( (u, m) => {
        const x = u.floor ?? 1
          , p = m.floor ?? 1;
        return x !== p ? r ? p - x : x - p : u.row !== m.row ? u.row - m.row : u.col - m.col
    }
    );
    if (l.length === 0)
        return a;
    const d = Math.max(...t.map(u => u.floor ?? 1), 1) > 1;
    if (i === "by_row") {
        const u = new Map;
        for (const m of l) {
            const p = `${m.floor ?? 1}-${m.row}`;
            u.has(p) || u.set(p, []),
            u.get(p).push(m)
        }
        for (const [m,x] of [...u.entries()].sort( ([p], [g]) => {
            const [f,j] = p.split("-").map(Number)
              , [N,b] = g.split("-").map(Number);
            return f !== N ? r ? N - f : f - N : j - b
        }
        )) {
            const [p,g] = m.split("-").map(Number);
            x.sort( (f, j) => f.col - j.col),
            x.forEach( (f, j) => {
                const N = d ? `A${p}-` : "";
                a.set(o(f), `${N}${g}${String.fromCharCode(65 + j)}`)
            }
            )
        }
    } else if (i === "brazilian_standard") {
        const u = Math.max(...l.map(f => f.col), 4)
          , m = Math.ceil(u / 2)
          , x = new Map;
        for (const f of l) {
            const j = `${f.floor ?? 1}-${f.row}`;
            x.has(j) || x.set(j, []),
            x.get(j).push(f)
        }
        const p = [...x.entries()].sort( ([f], [j]) => {
            const [N,b] = f.split("-").map(Number)
              , [y,S] = j.split("-").map(Number);
            return N !== y ? r ? y - N : N - y : b - S
        }
        );
        let g = 1;
        for (const [,f] of p) {
            const j = f.filter(y => y.col <= m).sort( (y, S) => y.col - S.col)
              , N = f.filter(y => y.col > m).sort( (y, S) => y.col - S.col);
            for (const y of j)
                a.set(o(y), String(g++));
            const b = g;
            for (let y = 0; y < N.length; y++)
                a.set(o(N[y]), String(b + (N.length - 1 - y)));
            g += N.length
        }
    } else
        l.forEach( (u, m) => {
            a.set(o(u), String(m + 1))
        }
        );
    return a
}

function $ee({stats: t}) {
    const s = [...t].sort( (a, n) => n.revenue - a.revenue).slice(0, 8);
    return e.jsxs(Y, {
        children: [e.jsx(ye, {
            children: e.jsxs(Ne, {
                className: "flex items-center gap-2",
                children: [e.jsx(yr, {
                    className: "w-4 h-4"
                }), "Metas vs Realizado — Por Vendedor"]
            })
        }), e.jsx(se, {
            children: s.length === 0 ? e.jsx("p", {
                className: "text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center py-4",
                children: "Sem dados de venda para exibir"
            }) : e.jsx("div", {
                className: "space-y-4",
                children: s.map(a => {
                    const n = a.user.monthlyGoal ?? 0
                      , r = n > 0 ? Math.min(100, a.revenue / n * 100) : 0;
                    return e.jsxs("div", {
                        className: "space-y-1",
                        children: [e.jsxs("div", {
                            className: "flex justify-between items-center text-sm",
                            children: [e.jsx("span", {
                                className: "font-medium",
                                children: a.user.name
                            }), e.jsxs("span", {
                                className: "text-muted-foreground",
                                children: [Et(a.revenue), n > 0 ? ` / ${Et(n)}` : " — sem meta"]
                            })]
                        }), n > 0 ? e.jsxs("div", {
                            className: "relative h-4 rounded-full bg-muted overflow-hidden",
                            children: [e.jsx("div", {
                                className: `h-full rounded-full transition-all ${r >= 100 ? "bg-green-500" : r >= 70 ? "bg-primary" : r >= 40 ? "bg-yellow-500" : "bg-red-400"}`,
                                style: {
                                    width: `${r}%`
                                }
                            }), e.jsxs("span", {
                                className: "absolute right-2 top-0 bottom-0 flex items-center text-xs font-bold text-foreground/80",
                                children: [r.toFixed(0), "%"]
                            })]
                        }) : e.jsx("div", {
                            className: "h-4 rounded-full bg-muted/50 flex items-center px-2",
                            children: e.jsx("span", {
                                className: "text-xs text-muted-foreground",
                                children: "Meta não configurada"
                            })
                        })]
                    }, a.user.id)
                }
                )
            })
        })]
    })
}

    const a = {};
    return t.forEach(n => {
        const r = n.stageName ?? n.stageId;

    }
    ),
    e.jsx("div", {

function ate(t) {
    const [s,a] = t.split("-");
    return new Date(Number(s),Number(a) - 1,1).toLocaleDateString("pt-BR", {
        month: "short",
        year: "2-digit",
        timeZone: "America/Sao_Paulo"
    }).replace(" de ", "/")
}
function Sf({current: t, prev: s, suffix: a=""}) {
    if (s === 0 && t === 0)
        return e.jsx("span", {
            className: "text-xs text-muted-foreground",
            children: "—"
        });
    const n = t - s;
    return n === 0 ? e.jsxs("span", {
        className: "text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1",
        children: [e.jsx(oc, {
            className: "w-3 h-3"
        }), "igual ao mês anterior"]
    }) : n > 0 ? e.jsxs("span", {
        className: "text-xs text-green-600 flex items-center gap-1",
        children: [e.jsx(ks, {
            className: "w-3 h-3"
        }), "+", n, a, " vs. mês anterior"]
    }) : e.jsxs("span", {
        className: "text-xs text-red-500 flex items-center gap-1",
        children: [e.jsx(Dr, {
            className: "w-3 h-3"
        }), n, a, " vs. mês anterior"]
    })
}

const jE = "/".replace(/\/$/, "");
async function dte() {
    const t = await fetch(`${jE}/api/club/ranking/full`, {
        credentials: "include"
    });
    if (!t.ok)
        throw new Error("Erro ao carregar ranking");
    return t.json()
}

}

    function S(B, M) {

function Die(t, s, a, n) {
    if (n.biff < 8)
        return so(t, s);
    for (var r = t.l + s, i = [], o = 0; o !== a.length; ++o)
        switch (a[o][0]) {
        case "PtgArray":
            a[o][1] = tie(t, 0, n),
            i.push(a[o][1]);
            break;
        case "PtgMemArea":
            a[o][2] = eie(t, a[o][1], n),
            i.push(a[o][2]);
            break;
        case "PtgExp":
            n && n.biff == 12 && (a[o][1][1] = t.read_shift(4),
            i.push(a[o][1]));
            break;
        case "PtgList":
        case "PtgElfRadicalS":
        case "PtgElfColS":
        case "PtgElfColSV":
            throw "Unsupported " + a[o][0]

function zie(t) {
    var s = "of:=" + t.replace(Xj, "$1[.$2$3$4$5]").replace(/\]:\[/g, ":");
    return s.replace(/;/g, "|").replace(/,/g, ";")
}
function Gie(t) {
    return t.replace(/\./, "!")

function Ice(t, s) {
    var a = "";
    switch ((s || {}).type || "base64") {
    case "buffer":
        return [t[0], t[1], t[2], t[3], t[4], t[5], t[6], t[7]];
    case "base64":
        a = Do(t.slice(0, 12));
        break;
    case "binary":
        a = t;
        break;
    case "array":
        return [t[0], t[1], t[2], t[3], t[4], t[5], t[6], t[7]];
    default:
        throw new Error("Unrecognized type " + (s && s.type || "undefined"))
    }
    return [a.charCodeAt(0), a.charCodeAt(1), a.charCodeAt(2), a.charCodeAt(3), a.charCodeAt(4), a.charCodeAt(5), a.charCodeAt(6), a.charCodeAt(7)]
}
function dT(t, s) {
    switch (s.type) {
    case "base64":
    case "binary":
        break;
    case "buffer":
    case "array":
        s.type = "";
        break;
    case "file":
        return mm(s.file, wa.write(t, {
            type: oa ? "buffer" : ""
        }));
    case "string":
        throw new Error("'string' output type invalid for '" + s.bookType + "' files");
    default:
        throw new Error("Unrecognized type " + s.type)
    }
    return wa.write(t, s)
}

function cde(t, s, a, n) {
    if (t < n)
        return null;
    const r = t.toFixed(1)
      , i = s.toLocaleString("pt-BR")
      , o = a.toLocaleString("pt-BR")
      , l = t >= 90;
    return {
        label: l ? `Redis: uso crítico (${r}% do limite diário)` : `Redis: uso elevado (${r}% do limite diário)`,
        description: `${i} de ${o} requisições usadas hoje. ${l ? "O serviço pode ser interrompido em breve. Reduza o polling ou atualize o plano." : "Considere reduzir a frequência de polling ou atualizar o plano Upstash."}`,
        classes: l ? "bg-red-50 border-red-300 text-red-800" : "bg-amber-50 border-amber-300 text-amber-800",
        iconClasses: l ? "text-red-500" : "text-amber-500"
    }
}

function Gf(t) {
    return t.toLowerCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "")
}

const wu = {
    azul: "#1E5B8C",
    verde: "#4C8B5F",
    dourado: "#D8A646",
    branco: "#FFFFFF",
    cinza: "#F5F7FA"
}
  , Hf = {
    primary: "#3b82f6",
    secondary: "#10b981",
    accent: "#f59e0b"
}
  , k1 = "#1f2937"
  , T1 = "#ffffff";
function Tx(t) {
    if (!t || typeof t != "string")
        return null;
    let s = t.trim().toLowerCase();
    return s.startsWith("#") || (s = `#${s}`),
    /^#[0-9a-f]{3}$/.test(s) && (s = `#${s[1]}${s[1]}${s[2]}${s[2]}${s[3]}${s[3]}`),
    /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/.test(s) ? s : null
}
function Qu(t) {
    const s = Tx(t) ?? "#000000";
    return {
        r: parseInt(s.slice(1, 3), 16),
        g: parseInt(s.slice(3, 5), 16),
        b: parseInt(s.slice(5, 7), 16)
    }
}
function Lue(t, s=0, a=255) {
    return Math.min(a, Math.max(s, t))
}
function $ue({r: t, g: s, b: a}) {
    const n = r => Lue(Math.round(r)).toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
    return `#${n(t)}${n(s)}${n(a)}`
}
function Wf(t) {
    const {r: s, g: a, b: n} = Qu(t)
      , r = i => {
        const o = i / 255;
        return o <= .03928 ? o / 12.92 : Math.pow((o + .055) / 1.055, 2.4)
    }
    ;
    return .2126 * r(s) + .7152 * r(a) + .0722 * r(n)
}
function A1(t, s) {
    const a = Math.max(t, s)
      , n = Math.min(t, s);
    return (a + .05) / (n + .05)
}
function Qf(t) {
    const s = Wf(t)
      , a = A1(s, Wf(k1))
      , n = A1(s, Wf(T1));
    return a >= n ? k1 : T1
}
function f0(t, s, a) {
    const n = Qu(t)
      , r = Qu(s)
      , i = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, a));
    return $ue({
        r: n.r + (r.r - n.r) * i,
        g: n.g + (r.g - n.g) * i,
        b: n.b + (r.b - n.b) * i
    })
}
function Yf(t, s) {
    return f0(t, "#000000", s)
}
function ax(t, s) {
    const {r: a, g: n, b: r} = Qu(t)
      , i = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, s));
    return `rgba(${a}, ${n}, ${r}, ${i})`
}
function Xf(t) {
    const {r: s, g: a, b: n} = Qu(t)
      , r = s / 255
      , i = a / 255
      , o = n / 255
      , l = Math.max(r, i, o)
      , c = Math.min(r, i, o)
      , d = (l + c) / 2;
    let u = 0
      , m = 0;
    if (l !== c) {
        const x = l - c;
        switch (m = d > .5 ? x / (2 - l - c) : x / (l + c),
        l) {
        case r:
            u = (i - o) / x + (i < o ? 6 : 0);
            break;
        case i:
            u = (o - r) / x + 2;
            break;
        default:
            u = (r - i) / x + 4
        }
        u /= 6
    }
    return `${Math.round(u * 360)} ${Math.round(m * 100)}% ${Math.round(d * 100)}%`
}
function que(t) {
    const s = Tx(t?.primaryColor)
      , a = Tx(t?.secondaryColor)
      , n = Tx(t?.accentColor)
      , r = s === Hf.primary && a === Hf.secondary && n === Hf.accent;

        secondary: wu.verde,
        accent: wu.dourado,
        isFallback: !0
    } : {
        primary: s,
        secondary: a,
        accent: n,
        isFallback: !1
    }
}

        "--vitrine-primary-fg": i.primaryForeground,
        "--vitrine-secondary-fg": i.secondaryForeground,
        "--vitrine-accent-fg": i.accentForeground,
        "--vitrine-primary-hover": i.primaryHover,
        "--vitrine-accent-hover": i.accentHover,
        "--vitrine-primary-soft": i.primarySoft,

function Jf(t) {
    const s = t - Date.now();
    if (s <= 0)
        return {
            expired: !0,
            days: 0,
            hours: 0,
            minutes: 0,
            seconds: 0
        };
    const a = Math.floor(s / 864e5)
      , n = Math.floor(s % 864e5 / 36e5)
      , r = Math.floor(s % 36e5 / 6e4)
      , i = Math.floor(s % 6e4 / 1e3);
    return {
        expired: !1,
        days: a,
        hours: n,
        minutes: r,
        seconds: i
    }
}
function Mc(t) {
    return String(t).padStart(2, "0")
}
